  || Wednesday Dinner ||

It was a random plan last wednesday to go out for dinner. I was craving for Buffet Food and we did not want to go far so we selected this place in Marathahalli for our dinner.

Ambience: I liked the ambience. Its all lighted up and has a bright touch to everything in the decor part.

Staff/Service: The staff and service were both good. No complains on this part.

Food: So this place serves Buffet. We took non-veg buffet. 1 Mocktail is complementary for each diner. The buffet food is more or less same every where. But few things which I totally loved here was the Tangri Kabab. The best Tangri Kabab I had eaten in any Buffet. And they had served one kind of steamed fish too in the starters which was absolutely mouth watering. Even chicken wings were great.

Rest things can be seen in the pics.

#PhoneCameraFoodLife #Buffet #DinnerBuffet #WednesdayDinnerScenes.'), ('Rated 5.0', 'RATED
  I went for team buffet lunch at this place and had an amazing dining experience here.
Starter food items like Cajun Potatoes, Broccoli and Crispy Corn tasted delicious.
Main Course had Veg Biryani, Palak Paneer, Mix Vegetables, Garlic Noodles, which did not disappoint at all.
They have a huge option in Desserts like Gulab Jamun, Jalebi, Gajar ka Halwa, Swiss Roles, Cakes and Pastries. Gajar ka Halwa was the best part among all these.
Highly recommended to dine out with great experience in this beautifully decorated place.'), ('Rated 3.0', "RATED
  I wonder how this restaurant is rated 4.8 after so many reviews. It makes me question how many of those are genuine reviews (not that I have any strong evidence of fake reviews). 

We had booked a table for team lunch in advance. When we reached there, even though the whole restaurant was vacant, the waiters / staff refused to give us any options for the table, which was weird. He didn't even want to join tables for us to sit together. 

Starters ( veg and non-veg) were decent. Fish / mushroom were good, other things were average. Complimentary mocktail tasted like Hajmola candy mixed in something, was just horrible. 

Main-course didn't have a lot of options. Biryani was okay-ish. Desserts didn't look appealing at all. After the lunch, the staff was suggesting us to write a zomato review immediately.   Despite the popularity of this place, I personally don't find it to be on my list of good restro-bars.

Food:
People mainly order finger food and appetizers here. But one afternoon my friends and I tried the main course items such as pasta and burgers which were decent. The appetizers are quite good.
Beverages:
The cocktails are either diluted or have an unpleasant taste if they're strong. I'd say stick to neat drinks and manually add soft drinks of your choice.
Cost:
The pricing is moderate but taking into account the poor ambience, the value for money isn't great.

  FOOD
The buffet was average, includes the same old spread available at other buffet centres. The taste of the food is ordinary.
1)Some of the dishes like Soups, barbequed guavas, paneer tikka was really bad.

2) Desserts like jalebi were served cold. And were hard in texture.

3) Variety was very less at a price of 700? ?

SERVICE
The service is very poor. We had to wait for 10 mins for each starter to turn up. Nobody really cared about our needs.

AMBIENCE
The ambience is unique, based on the ship Black Pearl in the movie Pirates of Caribbean. But the furniture looks 10th century old. Very untidy n cheap to use and enjoy surroundings. There was huge rush and we were made to sit on 1st floor, where it was so hot n suffocating.

Nothing 'hot & hit' about it. Wastage of money. Rating of 4.8 on Zomato is fake. I don't think people love it so much. It's disgusting?"), ('Rated 5.0', "RATED

  So 12th main indiranagar, near golds gym is where you will find this beautiful eatery. They start you off with a bread basket, which was really good.

  A day at brew and barbeque was well spent. We ordered papad ki tikki, niligiri paneer, chakori murgh tikki, Golconda chicken and tandoori prawns in starters. All of them were very good.
